data.name: Sharindra
data.long_meaning: The name Sharindra is derived from the Sanskrit words 'shari', which means 'Goddess', and 'indra', which means 'Lord of the Heavens'. This name is believed to represent the goddess of light, who is the source of all knowledge and wisdom. It symbolizes the power of the divine feminine and embodies courage, strength, and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sharindra holds significant spiritual meaning in Hinduism. It is believed to represent the goddess of light, Saraswati, who is the embodiment of knowledge, wisdom, and creativity. This name is said to bring blessings of enlightenment, wisdom, and success in all endeavors.
